text:
**Change:** The only error was an ERC violation: the start-up pull-up devices used L = 30 µm, but the maximum allowed is 20 µm. I replaced the two L = 30 µm PMOS devices with three series PMOS devices at L = 20 µm each. The total channel length stays at 60 µm, so the start-up leakage current (well under 0.5 µA) and the power budget are unchanged. The core, output branch and start-up logic are otherwise identical. This revision has not been simulated, so the other specs still need to be confirmed in the next run.

```spice
.subckt dut vdd vref vss
* ---- PTAT core: I = VT*ln(8)/R1 ~ 0.5 uA ----
Mp1  n1  n2  vdd vdd pfet W=20 L=2
Mp2  n2  n2  vdd vdd pfet W=20 L=2
Mn1  n1  n1  e1  vss nfet W=20 L=2
Mn2  n2  n1  r1  vss nfet W=20 L=2
Q1   vss vss e1  pnp m=1
R1   r1  e2  107.6k
Q2   vss vss e2  pnp m=8
* ---- output branch: Vref = (I*Rb + VBE)*Ra/(Ra+Rb) ----
Mp3  vref n2 vdd vdd pfet W=20 L=2
Ra   vref vss 4.3e6
Rb   vref e3  1.075e6
Q3   vss vss e3  pnp m=1
Cout vref vss 30p
Cpg  n2   vdd 2p
* ---- start-up (weak pull-up: 3 x L=20 in series = 60 um total) ----
Msp1 sm1 vss vdd vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Msp2 sm2 vss sm1 vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Msp3 sx  vss sm2 vdd pfet W=0.42 L=20
Msn  sx  vref vss vss nfet W=1 L=1
Mst  n2  sx  vss vss nfet W=0.42 L=1
.ends
```
